subject: SIG delivery: asset inventory gaps & timeline confirmation
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kyle Park <kyle.park@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire — asset inventory and attachments needed by May 3

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We started filling out the FIN_2027_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx your team shared and hit a gap on the asset inventory section. Our security team needs a mapping of cloud resources (VPCs, S3 buckets, K8s clusters) and any third-party data processors referenced in answers for sections 3.1–3.4.

We have a hard internal deadline of May 3 to complete the questionnaire and hand everything over to procurement. Can you confirm whether you can provide: 1) latest inventory export (CSV), 2) a completed draft of the SIG responses for any items requiring legal/engineering input, and 3) SOC2 evidence bundle pointer?

We appreciate a quick confirmation and any ETA.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
Security Operations Manager
Finlytics

----
Attachment: FIN_2027_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire — asset inventory and attachments needed by May 3

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear note and the deadline. Quick update: we can get you the inventory CSV and a draft of our SIG answers, but we have a couple of internal owners to pull in for authoritative wording (data residency, key management).

Action plan:
- I will attach the latest inventory export (aws-inventory-export-20270429.csv) by EOD today.
- Marissa will assemble the SOC2 evidence pointer and add any missing artifacts.
- Karthik will draft recommended answers for the data residency & controls language that typically need engineering review.

If May 3 is firm on your end, we will prioritize to hit that — I’ll confirm timing in the next update. If you can spare a 48-hour buffer that would help with sign-offs on a couple of items.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Trust & Safety Program Manager
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: aws-inventory-export-20270429.csv (csv stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T12:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire — asset inventory and attachments needed by May 3

Mina — attaching what I have so far: SOC2-evidence-bundle.zip contains the most recent SOC artifacts (control narratives, CC evidence indexes) and a drive folder with screenshots for IAM configurations. I also put a short index.csv that maps the SOC artifacts to the SIG questionnaire sections to speed intake.

Two quick notes:
- The inventory shows a handful of test buckets and an old EKS cluster (decommissioned, tag=decom-2026). Do you want those filtered out, or should we mark them as non-prod in the spreadsheet?
- Legal prefers we do not finalize any third-party processor descriptions without a brief review — I can flag the rows for legal sign-off.

Attaching draft pointers now. Will collaborate with Karthik on the residency language.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: SOC2-evidence-bundle.zip (zip stub), soc2_to_sig_index.csv (csv stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-30T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire — asset inventory and attachments needed by May 3

Thanks — quick technical callout: the SIG has two free-text areas where Finlytics usually asks for our data residency commitments and encryption key lifecycle. We have approved boilerplate for residency and KMS integration in our internal playbook (sig-responses-draft.docx).

I pulled the draft and marked two places that require confirmation from infra (region scoping of backups, cross-region replication). If infra confirms by EOD tomorrow I can finalize wording. Otherwise we should give Finlytics the draft with a short note that "replication policy is under final review and will be confirmed within 48 hours."

Also recommend we filter the inventory to omit decom-2026 resources before we hand it off. That will avoid noise in their intake.

-Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: sig-responses-draft.docx (docx stub)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@finlytics.com>
Cc: Kyle Park <kyle.park@finlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: SIG questionnaire — asset inventory and attachments needed by May 3

Sarah — thanks for the patience. Deliverables and ETA below: 

1) Inventory CSV: aws-inventory-export-20270429.csv (we will send a filtered version excluding decom-2026 resources by EOD today).
2) SIG response draft: attached docx (sig-responses-draft.docx) with residency language flagged; Karthik will finalize pending infra confirmation expected within 24–48 hrs.
3) SOC2 pointer: link and bundled zip (SOC2-evidence-bundle.zip) + index mapping file.

If you can accept the draft + flagged note for the two residency items, we will meet your May 3 intake. If your procurement team cannot accept pending confirmations, please let us know and we can request a 48-hour extension while infra returns final confirmations.

Delivering attachments to your drive link now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cDEFG (I’ll post the filtered inventory there).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Trust & Safety Program Manager
Redwood Inference

----
Attachments: aws-inventory-export-20270429.csv (csv stub), sig-responses-draft.docx (docx stub), SOC2-evidence-bundle.zip (zip stub)
